title: Thomas Saujet’s Luxe Fragrance Debut: Lalique Bottles, 60 Percent Concentrations, and a Dash of Mediterranean Glamour
summary: Saujet, the haute parfumerie fragrance house, will launch on Oct. 20 with a pop-up in Neiman Marcus Beverly Hills.
